updateDescription:
Updates bring new features and fixes ({{changelog}}).
There is also a small risk of data loss, so we recommend backing up your Commander first.
backupExplanation: Keep this ZIP backup somewhere safe in case the update causes a problem with your Commander.
downloadFailedTitle: The update could not be downloaded
installationUnchangedAfterDownloadFailur: Your current installation has not been changed.
downloadCanBeRetried: You can retry the download now or later.
backupFailed: The Commander backup could not be created.
installBlockedBySafetySaveFailure: The safety save could not be created, so the update installation was not started.
